email.body1:
Josh, saw Coactive stand up a Media and Entertainment Advisory Board and land on Azure with Visual AI Search.

Moving into a new channel and vertical at once usually means more accounts in play than the team can cover before the motion is fully staffed, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new hires: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Coactive off your launch and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Josh, quick follow-up for Coactive.

With the Azure motion and an M&E push running together, expectations on pipeline usually jump faster than headcount can. Most teams do not know how many meetings they actually need to book to hit the number, so the gap shows up late.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Coactive needs to hit target this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Josh, last bit of proof for Coactive.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Coactive's reply rate likely compares to other AI startups. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Josh, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Launching a new channel and vertical at once is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to Coactive either way.
